lines.en: label ayanespecial40:
scene ayanecantbone1
I’m not going to lie, not having Makoto around fucking sucks.
lines.zh: 说真的，Makoto 不在真是他妈的难受。

lines.en: Because, in addition to being one of the girls I am currently allowed to have sex with (Thanks, Maya), her {i}not{/i} being here is beginning to increase the amount of time I have to spend in this building.
lines.zh: 因为除了她是我目前被允许与之发生关系的女生之一（谢了，Maya）之外，她{i}不在{/i}还让我不得不在这栋楼里待上更久。

lines.en: And it certainly doesn’t help that Imani is a pretty good teacher and has actually started assigning work to the girls.
lines.zh: 而 Imani 是个相当不错的老师，居然真的开始给女生们布置作业了，这一点也完全没帮上忙。

lines.en: Now, you may be asking yourself, just how much paperwork can there possibly {i}be{/i} for a class of twenty-ish who receive maybe one written assignment per week. And the answer to that is simple.
lines.zh: 你可能会问，一个二十来人的班级，一周大概才交一次书面作业，到底能{i}有{/i}多少文书工作。答案很简单。

lines.en: There is paperwork.
lines.zh: 有。

lines.en: It’s not a large amount. In fact, the amount I have to handle is so minuscule that I’m sure Wakana would mock and ridicule me if she could only hear my thoughts.
lines.zh: 量不算大。事实上，我要处理的那点东西少得可怜，我敢肯定要是 Wakana 能听见我的想法，一定会狠狠嘲笑我。

lines.en: But when you don’t want to work, any amount of work at all is too much.
lines.zh: 但人一旦不想干活，再少的活也嫌多。

lines.en: I have far too many things to think about.
lines.zh: 要想的事情实在太多了。

lines.en: And far too many girls to have sex with.
lines.zh: 能上床的女生也实在太多了。

lines.en: : Come in.
lines.zh: : 进来。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone2
Or not.
lines.zh: 也可能不进来。

lines.en: : Good! You’re still here. I was worried you may have left with Ami and Maya.
lines.zh: : 太好了！你还在。我还担心你已经跟 Ami 和 Maya 走了。

lines.en: : Is there any reason {i}you{/i} didn’t leave with Ami and Maya?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}没跟 Ami 和 Maya 一起走，是有原因的？

lines.en: : Swim club, obviously.
lines.zh: : 游泳社啊，显而易见。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. I can see that it’s going very well by the fact that...you are here and not there.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。从“你在这儿而不是在那儿”这一点，我看得出来它进行得十分顺利。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone3
: Yeah...I got halfway there and then thought to myself- you know what, Ayane? It’s been a long time since you’ve hung out with Sensei in his office after school. You should go do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我走到一半，然后对自己说——你知道吗，Ayane？你已经很久没有放学后跑到 Sensei 办公室陪他了。你应该去。

lines.en: : Good on you for being mentally stable. You’ll have more free time that way.
lines.zh: : 精神状态能这么稳定，很好。这样你空闲时间也更多。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone4
: I wouldn’t mind being a little crazier if it meant I got to spend more time with you.
lines.zh: : 如果能多跟你待在一起，我不介意自己再疯一点。

lines.en: : And, at the rate things have been going lately, that seems like it might be a real possibility!
lines.zh: : 而且看最近这个发展速度，这似乎还真有可能！

lines.en: : Is the fact that this is all some sort of infinite cycle finally starting to weigh on you?
lines.zh: : 这一切都是某种无限循环这件事，终于开始压到你身上了？

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone5
: Of course. I just haven’t quite figured out the right way to talk about it yet because I don’t understand nearly as much as you and Maya even {i}with{/i} all of the questions I’ve asked her.
lines.zh: : 当然。我只是还没找到合适的说法，因为{i}就算{/i}我问了她那么多问题，我懂的也远不如你和 Maya 多。

lines.en: : Which is doubly annoying since it’s starting to seem like being the “runner up” just might be who I am as a person.
lines.zh: : 更让人恼火的是，我渐渐开始觉得，“第二名”大概就是我这个人的本质。

lines.en: : You’re not a runner up at all, Ayane. You’re...Well, you’re you.
lines.zh: : 你根本不是什么第二名，Ayane。你是……好吧，你就是你。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone6
: Yeah. Second place to Ami when it comes to your list of interpersonal priorities and second to Maya when it comes to your list of...apocalyptic ones.
lines.zh: : 是啊。在人际关系的优先榜上排在 Ami 之后，在……末日的优先榜上排在 Maya 之后。

lines.en: : If you weight the points you get from both of those categories, I think that would put you in first.
lines.zh: : 要是把这两项的得分加权算一下，我觉得你会是第一名。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone7
: Sensei, I’m being serious right now. This is all still really scary to me and there are so many things I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我现在是认真的。这一切对我来说还是很可怕，而且我有太多事搞不懂。

lines.en: : Also, I’m worried that if I have to go any longer without having sex with you that my vagina is going to close up and we’ll never be able to have sex again.
lines.zh: : 还有，我担心再这么久不跟你做爱，我的阴道就要闭合了，那样我们就再也做不成了。

lines.en: : What were you saying about going insane just a minute ago? Because I think that sentence may have just put you over the edge.
lines.zh: : 你一分钟前说自己要疯了是怎么说的来着？因为我觉得刚才那句话可能已经把你推过去了。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone8
: You know...when I first heard that abstinence suggestion thingy from Maya...I thought to myself, “That sounds hard and annoying...but I think I can do it for the sake of science.”
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我第一次从 Maya 那儿听到禁欲建议的时候……我心里想：“听起来又难又烦……不过为了科学，我觉得我能做到。”

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone9
: Now? Now, I just want you to pin me down and fuck my brains out until I can’t even move anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在呢？现在我只想让你把我按在地上，操到我脑子都化了，直到我连动都动不了。

lines.en: : Please don’t say things like that to me when I’ve been doing so well with this so far.
lines.zh: : 拜托别在我一直忍得这么好的时候跟我说这种话。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone6
: But...Sensei! Think about it for a second...
lines.zh: : 可是……Sensei！你想想看嘛……

lines.en: : Why should we even have to do this in the first place? It doesn’t make any sense.
lines.zh: : 我们到底凭什么非得做这种事？一点道理都没有。

lines.en: : It’s for Maya’s...theory or whatever.
lines.zh: : 是为了 Maya 的……理论之类。

lines.en: : Yes, I know that. But what would even be the point of proving that theory?
lines.zh: : 对，我知道。可证明那个理论又有什么意义？

lines.en: : Isn’t me finally showing up after...the bajillions of times you guys have done it a step in the {i}right{/i} direction? Won’t getting rid of me just send you backwards?
lines.zh: : 在你们做了……好几亿次之后，我终于出现了，这不才是朝着{i}正确{/i}方向迈出的一步吗？把我排除掉，不就反而让你倒退了吗？

lines.en: : First off, I’ve only done it a handful of times. Maya’s the one who has reached  “bajillions” territory...possibly.
lines.zh: : 首先，我也就做过几次而已。达到“好几亿次”量级的是 Maya……大概。

lines.en: : I’m fine with suffering for the sake of you being happy. I am. But-
lines.zh: : 为了让你幸福，我受点苦没关系。真的没关系。可是——

lines.en: : I’m not asking you to {i}suffer,{/i} Ayane. In fact, I’m not the one asking you anything at all.
lines.zh: : 我没有要你{i}受苦{/i}，Ayane。事实上，我什么都没要求过你。

lines.en: : I know. You’d never ask me to do something like that. But the truth is that I {i}am.{/i} And I’m not just talking about the sex at this point even if that {i}is{/i} an admittedly huge part of it.
lines.zh: : 我知道。你永远不会要求我做那种事。可事实是，我{i}确实在受苦{/i}。而且我现在说的已经不只是性了，尽管性{i}确实{/i}占了很大一部分。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone10
: I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I can’t help but feel like if Maya is right and everything {i}does{/i} work out...
lines.zh: : 我忍不住觉得，如果 Maya 是对的，如果一切{i}真的{/i}顺利……

lines.en: : That I’ll just go back to being excluded again...
lines.zh: : 那我就会重新被排除在外……

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone11
: Listen, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……

lines.en: : Can we sit on the couch if I promise not to try and have sex with you? Doing things this way makes it feel too much like counseling and I kind of need you to feel like {i}you{/i} right now.
lines.zh: : 如果我保证不对你动手动脚，我们能坐到沙发上去吗？这样隔着桌子说话太像在做心理咨询了，我现在需要你像平时的{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Sure. But I’m blaming you if Imani yells at me for not finishing all of this grading stuff on time.
lines.zh: : 行。不过要是 Imani 因为我没按时改完这些作业而骂我，我就怪你。

lines.en: : I probably shouldn’t be encouraging this type of behavior when the school has already decided you needed a student teacher, but...grades should be the last of your priorities right now...
lines.zh: : 学校都已经认定你需要一个实习老师了，我大概不该再纵容你这种行为，不过……成绩现在应该是你最不关心的事……

lines.en: scene black
Ayane moves over to the couch and curls herself up into a ball, waiting for me to come join her as I slide the remainder of my “work” back into my desk.
lines.zh: Ayane 挪到沙发上蜷成一团，等着我也过去；我把剩下的“工作”塞回办公桌。

lines.en: I understand where these worries are coming from. Especially when, for the most part, she’s kept them bottled up ever since the three of us “respawned” in this very room.
lines.zh: 我明白这些忧虑从何而来。尤其是自从我们三个在这个房间里“重生”之后，她大部分时间都把它们憋在心里。

lines.en: But that’s what Ayane does. She keeps things to herself until she literally can’t anymore.
lines.zh: 但 Ayane 就是这样。她会把事情藏在心里，直到真的藏不住为止。

lines.en: And if she’s worried enough about this to actively seek me out...and shirk responsibilities she personally signed up for...
lines.zh: 如果她担心到主动来找我……甚至还翘了自己报名参加的社团……

lines.en: Something must really be wrong.
lines.zh: 那肯定是真的很不对劲了。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone12
: Thank you. I needed this.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。我需要这样。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’ll sound stupid since it’s something you’ve been shouldering for a long time, but...I guess my shoulders aren’t as big as yours. Which means this whole thing has been really hard for me so far.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来很蠢，因为这件事你已经扛了很久了，可是……我想我的肩膀没你的宽。所以到目前为止，这一切对我来说真的很辛苦。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone13
: And you’ve been great...really.
lines.zh: : 而你一直都很好……真的。

lines.en: : But...Maya, on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 可是……Maya 那边就……

lines.en: : Maya cares about you.
lines.zh: : Maya 是在乎你的。

lines.en: : Does she?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Uh...probably? I guess it’s hard to ever really know {i}anything{/i} with-
lines.zh: : 呃……大概吧？我想跟她相处，很难真的搞清楚{i}任何事{/i}——

lines.en: : If she cares about me, why is her top priority right now making sure I don’t get any closer to either one of you?
lines.zh: : 如果她在乎我，为什么她现在的第一要务是防止我跟你们俩任何一个更亲近？

lines.en: : If the whole pregnancy theory thing is true and I don’t get to come with you guys to the roof next time...won’t I just be...you know, reset? Why would she do that to me?
lines.zh: : 如果那个怀孕理论是真的，而下次我又不能跟你们一起上天台……那我不就……你知道的，被重置了吗？她为什么要这样对我？

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone14
: That’s not {i}exactly{/i} how things work, I don’t think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得事情{i}大概{/i}不是这么运作的。

lines.en: : It seems that, so long as nothing happens to me, everyone keeps most of their memories. And only {i}some{/i} things wind up getting wiped away after Maya does...whatever it is she does.
lines.zh: : 看来只要我这边不出事，大家都会保留大部分记忆。Maya 做完她那套……不管是什么之后，只有{i}一部分{/i}东西会被抹掉。

lines.en: : But those are still {i}my{/i} memories. Memories I want to keep because they’re memories that brought me closer to you.
lines.zh: : 可那些仍然是属于{i}我的{/i}记忆。是我想留住的记忆，因为正是它们让我离你更近。

lines.en: : It shouldn’t be up to Maya to decide that I should just throw them away to put an end to a little bet that she has with herself.
lines.zh: : 凭什么由 Maya 来决定，要我为了结束一个她跟自己打的赌，就把它们扔掉。

lines.en: : If you’re so confident that her theory is wrong...it shouldn’t be a problem, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 可如果你这么确信她的理论是错的……那就应该没问题啊，对吧？

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone15
: I mean...kind of?
lines.zh: : 嗯……算是吧？

lines.en: : I guess?...
lines.zh: : 大概吧？……

lines.en: : It’s less about the theory itself and more about what asking us to go through with it means.
lines.zh: : 问题其实不在于理论本身，而在于让我们照做的这个要求意味着什么。

lines.en: : I still think she’s wrong and I still think I’ll be able to stay with you guys, but I’m worried that she doesn’t {i}want{/i} me to.
lines.zh: : 我依然觉得她是错的，也依然觉得我能留在你们身边，但我担心的是她并不{i}想{/i}让我留下。

lines.en: : Like she...wants this weird, paranormal universe to be one for just the two of you. And that she’s so used to different versions of me getting discarded that I’m barely even a human to her anymore.
lines.zh: : 就好像她……想让这个诡异的超自然宇宙只属于你们两个人。而且她已经习惯了看着一个个不同版本的我被丢掉，以至于我在她眼里几乎都不算人了。

lines.en: : I wish...she wasn’t so hard to understand sometimes, you know?
lines.zh: : 我真希望……她有时候别那么难懂，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Trust me. I know.
lines.zh: : 相信我，我懂。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone16
: So...what now, then? What else can we do while we wait for the next {i}thing{/i} to happen?
lines.zh: : 那么……现在怎么办？在等下{i}一件事{/i}发生的时候，我们还能做点什么？

lines.en: : Just...wait, I guess. That’s all I normally do.
lines.zh: : 就……等吧，我猜。我平时就是这么过来的。

lines.en: : No wonder you guys haven’t made any progress. There has to be, like...{i}something{/i} we can do to find out more about this, right?
lines.zh: : 难怪你们一点进展都没有。总该有……{i}什么{/i}办法能查出更多线索吧？

lines.en: : Sure. It’s never too late to start studying chronokinetics. Act now and Wakana may even take you into her class. You’ll certainly have more luck with something like that there.
lines.zh: : 当然有。现在开始研究时间动力学也不算晚。现在行动，Wakana 说不定还会把你收进她的班。你去那儿研究这种东西，运气肯定更好。

lines.en: : Sensei-
lines.zh: : Sensei——

lines.en: : I don’t know what you want me to say, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你想让我说什么，Ayane。

lines.en: : I get that you’re scared. And I’m here to...try and make you feel better in whatever sort of sexless way I can.
lines.zh: : 我明白你害怕。而我在这里，是为了……尽力用任何不涉及性的方式让你好受一点。

lines.en: : But, despite having experienced this more than you, I really don’t know that much. And I have no idea what we can do to find out more.
lines.zh: : 可是，尽管我经历的次数比你多，我知道的其实也很少。我完全不知道我们还能做些什么来查清楚。

lines.en: : If you have any ideas, I’ll be happy to indulge them. But right now, all we have is Maya’s...so I still think the best course of action is just figuring out if she’s right or not.
lines.zh: : 如果你有什么想法，我很乐意奉陪。但现在我们手里只有 Maya 的……所以我还是觉得最好的做法，就是先弄清楚她对不对。

lines.en: : If she’s right, though...aren’t you worried that the current {i}me{/i} won’t come back?
lines.zh: : 可如果她是对的……你就不担心现在的{i}我{/i}再也回不来了吗？
: 或者……

lines.en: : Or will any old version of me do?...
lines.zh: : 或者说，随便哪个版本的我都行？……

lines.en: : What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思？

lines.en: : Do you love me?...Or do you love {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你爱的是我吗？……还是说{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : That is...way too deep of a question for regular office hours.
lines.zh: : 这问题……放在普通办公时间里问，也太深了。

lines.en: : Besides, Maya finding out that she’s wrong about the one thing she thinks she knows more about than everyone could be a very humbling experience for her and, not gonna lie, I think she needs that.
lines.zh: : 再说，让 Maya 发现她自认比所有人都懂的那一件事其实是错的，对她来说会是一次非常挫败的体验，说实话，我觉得她需要这个。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone17

: Fine. But just so you know, if I make it to that roof again after X months of not having sex with you and {i}don’t{/i} have my brain wiped, I am throwing myself at you with a level of aggression you have never seen before.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过先说清楚，要是在跟你禁欲了 X 个月之后我还能再上天台，而且记忆{i}没{/i}被抹掉，我会用你从未见过的凶猛程度扑向你。

lines.en: : I don’t think Maya will be very happy about that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Maya 不会太高兴。

lines.en: : I honestly don’t care.
lines.zh: : 说实话我不在乎。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. If we manage to prove that’s not why you’re showing up, I’m not going to reject any of your advances.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……嗯。如果真能证明那不是你出现的原因，我不会拒绝你的任何攻势。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone18
: We?
: So...you’re on my side now?
lines.zh: : 所以……你现在站我这边了？

lines.en: : There are sides? Is my life not already complicated enough having to fend off so many girls vying for my affection?
lines.zh: : 还有阵营？光是要应付那么多争抢我的感情的女生，我的人生还不够复杂吗？

lines.en: : Oh, please. As if you’re fighting any of them off.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。你根本一个都没在抵挡。

lines.en: : I’m not talking about an Ayane vs Maya, choose your heroine battle. I’m talking about whether or not you think getting me pregnant is the key to all of this world’s mysteries.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是什么 Ayane 对 Maya、选女主角那种事。我说的是，你觉不觉得让我怀孕是解开这个世界所有谜团的钥匙。

lines.en: : I think that if it {i}is,{/i} I am going to be more confused than ever. So, sure. Go ahead and chalk that up to me being on your {i}side.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果{i}是{/i}，那我只会比以前更困惑。所以，行吧。你就当这是我站{i}你这边{/i}的证据。

lines.en: : But I will not get sucked into whatever spat you and Maya start with one another. So please do not tell her I said that.
lines.zh: : 但我不会卷进你和 Maya 之间任何一场口角。所以千万别告诉她我说过这话。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone12
: I won’t. I don’t have any intention of starting any problems with Maya. I love her.
lines.zh: : 我不会的。我根本没打算跟 Maya 起什么冲突。我爱她。

lines.en: : I just don’t want her trying to tackle this entire burden herself when she finally has a friend willing to take on some of it for her.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想看她硬要一个人扛下这整副重担，明明她终于有了一个愿意替她分担一点的朋友。

lines.en: : I have no idea what the future holds for any of us...and despite how confident I am, I can’t even guarantee {i}my{/i} short-term future anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我们任何人的未来会怎样……而且不管我多自信，我连{i}自己{/i}短期的未来都没法保证了。

lines.en: : And who knows? Maybe we never wind up learning anything.
lines.zh: : 而且谁知道呢？也许我们到最后什么都没弄明白。

lines.en: : Maybe this loop never breaks and we all wind up complacently conquering the end of the world together. Over and over and over and over...
lines.zh: : 也许这个循环永远不会打破，我们会一直沾沾自喜地一起征服世界末日。一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍……

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone18
: But we’ll be doing it together.
lines.zh: : 但我们会一起做。

lines.en: : And none of us will ever have to feel...left out or...
lines.zh: : 而且我们再也不用觉得自己被撇下，或者……

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone19
: Or like we’re the runner up ever again.
lines.zh: : 或者觉得自己又是个第二名。

lines.en: : I do love {i}you,{/i} you know.
lines.zh: : 我是爱{i}你{/i}的，你知道吧。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone20
: Huh?
: To answer your question from before.
lines.zh: : 算是回答你刚才那个问题。

lines.en: : The {i}you{/i} you are now is the only Ayane Amamiya I care about. And if anything were to ever happen to {i}you,{/i} I doubt I’d be able to look at you the same.
lines.zh: : 现在的{i}你{/i}，就是我唯一在乎的那个 Ayane Amamiya。要是{i}你{/i}出了什么事，我怀疑我没法再用同样的眼光看你。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean I wouldn’t still have sex with the other Ayanes.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表我就不会跟别的那些 Ayane 上床。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone21
: I can’t tell if I’m horny because of the way you just told me you loved me, the fact that we haven’t had sex in what feels like a whole year, or the idea of you having sex with my clones.
lines.zh: : 我都分不清自己发情是因为你刚才跟我说了爱我，还是因为我们已经感觉上整整一年没做过，还是因为你跟我的克隆体上床这个念头。

lines.en: : Cloning you sounds fun. I don’t think I’d be able to handle more than three Ayanes at once, though.
lines.zh: : 克隆你听起来挺好玩的。不过我一次大概伺候不了三个以上的 Ayane。

lines.en: : I think I would also cut myself off at three Senseis.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我最多也就接受三个 Sensei。

lines.en: : That sounds...painful.
lines.zh: : 听起来……会很痛。

lines.en: : That sounds {i}amazing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 听起来{i}棒极了{/i}。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone22
: Okay! We should probably call it a day here since I know what you are thinking and you know what I am thinking.
lines.zh: : 好啦！今天就到这里吧，毕竟我知道你在想什么，你也知道我在想什么。

lines.en: : If Hell exists, this is it.
lines.zh: : 如果地狱存在，这就是地狱。

lines.en: scene ayanecantbone23
: Yes, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 是的，Sensei。

lines.en: : Yes it is.
lines.zh: : 确实如此。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane leaves my office and...
lines.zh: Ayane 离开了我的办公室，然后……

lines.en: And I wind up heading over to the school restroom to {i}relieve{/i} myself before going home for the day.
lines.zh: 然后我在回家之前，跑去学校的洗手间{i}解决{/i}了自己一下。

lines.en: Maya is lucky that I feel like my existence rests in the palms of her hands. Because otherwise, I would have gone against her wishes at least three times in the last hour.
lines.zh: Maya 真走运，我总觉得自己的存在就捏在她手心里。否则，刚才那一个小时里我至少已经违背她的意愿三次了。
